text: Lis protestis a son stadis a Parîs, a Sofie in Bulgarie, a Vilnius in Lituanie, a Valletta a Malte, a Tallin in Estonie e a Edimburc e Glasgow in Scozie.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: A Londre, cirche 200 personis a àn protestât fûr dai uficis di cualchidun dai principâi detentôrs dai dirits di autôr.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Il mês passât a son stadis grandis protestis in Polonie cuant che il guvier al à firmât l’ACTA, che a àn puartât il guvier polac a decidi di no ratificâ l’acuardi par cumò.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Letonie e Slovachie a àn intardât dutis dôs il procès di union al ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation e la Societât reâl pe prevenzion de crudeltât ai animâi (RSPCA) a stan domandant di gnûf la instalazion obligatorie di telecjamaris CCTV in ducj i macei de Australie.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: L’ispetôr cjâf da la RSPCA dal Gnûf Gales dal Sud, David O'Shannessy, al à declarât a la ABC che il control e lis ispezions dai macei a varessin di jessi une pratiche comun in Australie.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "Lis telecjamaris CCTV dal sigûr a saressin un fuart segnâl par chei che a lavorin cu lis bestiis, che il lôr benstâ al à di jessi la plui grande prioritât."
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La mape internazionâl dai taramots de Agjenzie gjeologjiche dai Stâts Unîts no mostrave nissun taramot in Islande te setemane prime.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Ancje l’Ufici meteorologjic islandês nol veve regjistrade nissune ativitât sismiche te zone di Hekla tes 48 oris prin.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: La ativitât sismiche significative che e puartà al cambiament di fase e jere sucedude ai 10 di Març te bande Nord orientâl dal cratêr su la piche dal vulcan.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Nûi scûrs no leâts ae ativitât vulcaniche a forin regjistrâts dapît de mont.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: I nûi a jerin un pussibil motîf di confusion par capî se e jere stade pardabon une eruzion.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: La Luno e puartave 120–160 metris cubics di carburant cuant che si è crevade e l’aiar fuart e lis ondis la àn sburtade viers il fermeondis.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: I elicotars a àn socorût i dodis membris dal ecuipaç e la uniche lesion e je stade un nâs rot.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: La nâf lungje 100 metris e stave lant a cjapâ sù la solite cjame di fertilizant e in principi i uficiâi a vevin pôre che e podès dispierdi une cjame.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: La propueste di emendament e veve za passât dutis dôs lis cjamaris tal 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Vie par cheste session legjislative, al è stât fat un cambiament: la seconde frase e je stade scancelade de Cjamare dai rapresentants e lunis e je stade aprovade in forme simile dal Senât.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: La mancjance de seconde frase, che e propon di vietâ lis unions civîls jenfri omosessuâi, e podarès menâ a une aprovazion des unions civîls plui indenant.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Stant daûr al procès, l’emendament HJR-3 al vignarà riviodût inte prossime legjislature, tal 2015 o tal 2016, par che al resti tal procès.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Di là de regjie, i travuarts di Vautier a includin un siopar de fam tal 1973 cuintri chê che par lui e jere censure politiche.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La leç francese e fo cambiade. Il so ativisim al va indaûr a cuant che a 15 agns al è jentrât te Resistence francese inte Seconde vuere mondiâl.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Si è contât intun libri tal 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Tai agns '60 dal Nûfcent al tornà in Alzerie, a pene deventade indipendente, par insegnâ regjie cinematografiche.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: L’atlete di judo gjaponês Hitoshi Saito, vincidôr di dôs medaiis di aur a lis Olimpiadis, al è muart a 54 agns.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Al è stât comunicât che la cause de muart e je un cancar intraepatic dal condot biliâr.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Al è muart martars a Osaka.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Sore jessi stât un campion mondiâl e olimpic, Saito tal moment de muart al jere ancje il president de Comission par la formazion de Federazion gjaponese di Judo.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Almancul 100 personis a jerin ladis ae fieste par celebrâ il prin aniversari di matrimoni di une cubie che si jere maridade l’an passât.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Daûr i uficiâi, un event celebratîf dal aniversari plui formâl al veve di jessi fat plui indenant.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: La cubie si jere maridade in Texas un an indaûr e e jere lade a Buffalo par celebrâ cun amîs e famee.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: L’om (30 agns), che al jere nassût a Buffalo, al è un dai cuatri copâts inte sbarade, ma la sô femine no je stade feride.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno al è un insegnant di inglês cognossût ma dibatût che al à insegnât intes scuelis Modern Education e King’s Glory e che al à dit che al colm de sô cariere al veve 9.000 students.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Tes sôs notis al doprave peraulis che daûr cualchi gjenitôr a jerin volgârs e al è stât riferît che al diseve ancje blestemis in classe.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: La scuele Modern Education lu à acusât di vê stampât e metût cence autorizazion sore lis corieris grancj manifescj publicitaris e di vê mintît disint che al jere l’insegnant cjâf di inglês.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: In passât al jere ancje stât acusât di violazion dai dirits di autôr ma nol jere stât incriminât.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un ex student al à dit che al 'fevelave in dialet a lezion, al insegnave cemût fâ concuistis amorosis e al jere come un amì dai students.'
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Tai ultins trente agns, ancje se a nivel uficiâl e reste un stât comunist, la Cine e à disvilupât une economie di marcjât.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Lis primis riformis economichis a son stadis fatis sot de vuide di Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Di in chê volte la economie cinese e je cressude di 90 voltis.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pe prime volte, l’an passât la Cine e à espuartât plui machinis de Gjermanie e e à passât i Stâts Unîts come marcjât plui grant in cheste industrie.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Il prodot interni totâl de Cine in vincj agns al podarès passâ chel dai Stâts Unîts.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La burascje tropicâl Danielle, la cuarte burascje cuntun non te stagjon dai uragans tal Atlantic dal 2010, si è formade intal ocean Atlantic orientâl.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La burascje, situade a cirche 3.000 miis di Miami in Floride, e à colps di aiar di massim 40 miis la ore (o sei 64 chilometris la ore).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: I sienziâts dal Centri nazionâl pai uragans a proviodin che Danielle e deventarà un uragan par miercus.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Stant che la burascje e je lontane de tiere ferme, al è dificil valutâ il risi potenziâl pai Stâts Unîts e lis Antilis.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek, nassût inte capitâl cravuate Zagabrie, al deventà famôs zuiant cul Partizan di Belgrât.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Al è jentrât inte scuadre tal 1945 e al è restât cun chê fin tal 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Vie pal timp che al è stât inte scuadre al à fat 403 goi in 468 partidis.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nissun altri al à mai zuiât in cussì tantis partidis e fat cussì tancj goi par chê scuadre come Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Tal 1995 al è stât nomenât come miôr zuiadôr de storie dal Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Lis celebrazions a son tacadis cuntune esibizion speciâl dal grup famôs in dut il mont dal Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Dopo e je stade la volte de Orchestre sinfoniche di stât di Istanbul, de bande dai Janizars e dai cjantants Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Dopo a son lâts sul palc i dervìs rotants.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La stele turche Sezen Aksu e à cjantât cul tenôr talian Alessandro Safina e il cjantant grêc Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Par finî, il grup di bal turc Fire of Anatolia si è esibît cul spetacul "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un pilote di moto di 13 agns, al è muart dopo vê fat un incident al autodrom di Indianapolis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Vier par il zîr di riscjaldament, Lenz al è colât jù de moto e al è stât cjapât sot di un altri pilote, Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Il personâl medic in piste al è rivât a colp a socorilu, e al è stât menât intun ospedâl locâl, dulà che dopo al è muart.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat al è vignût fûr salf dal incident.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Rispiet ae situazion finanziarie mondiâl, Zapatero al è lât indevant disint che "il sisteme finanziari al è part de economie, al è une part cruciâl.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: O sin dentri di une crisi finanziarie di un an che e je rivade al colm intai ultins doi mês, e o crôt che cumò i marcjâts finanziaris a stedin scomençant a ripiâsi."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La setemane passade, Naked News e à comunicât che e varès aumentât une vore il numar di lenghis dopradis pe informazion gjornalistiche, cun trê gnovis trasmissions.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: La organizazion mondiâl, che e trasmet za par inglês e gjaponês, e mandarà fûr programs pe television, par internet e pai dispositîfs mobii ancje in lenghe spagnole, taliane e coreane.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Par fortune no mi è capitât nuie a me, ma o ai viodût une sene macabre cuant che la int e cirive di spacâ i barcons par jessî fûr.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: La int e colpive i veris cu lis cjadreis ma i barcons a jerin infrangjibii.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Un dai veris ae fin si è rot e ducj a àn tacât a saltâ fûr pal barcon," al à dit il sorevivût Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Lis stelis a produsin lûs e calôr in gracie de energjie produsude cuant che i atoms di idrogjen si scuintrin (o si fondin) insiemi e a formin elements plui pençs.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: I sienziâts a stan lavorant par creâ un reatôr che al produsi energjie inte stesse maniere.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Chest, però, al è un probleme une vore dificil di risolvi e a coventaran tancj agns prin di rivâ ae costruzion di reatôrs a fusion doprabii.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: La gusiele di açâl e sta parsore la aghe in gracie de tension de superficie.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Si à tension inte superficie parcè che lis moleculis di aghe inte superficie de aghe si tirin dongje insiemi cun plui fuarce che cu lis moleculis dal aiar parsore di lôr.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Lis moleculis di aghe a produsin une piel invisibile inte superficie de aghe che e permet a robis come la gusiele di stâ parsore de aghe.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Il fier di sgliciâ moderni al à dôs lamis separadis di une part ingjavade. Lis dôs lamis a permetin une miôr prese dal glaç ancje cuant che a son in clin.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Stant che il font de lame al è un pôc arcât, cuant che la lame si incline di une bande o di chê altre, si incline ancje l’ôr in contat cul glaç.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Cussì il patinadôr al volte. Se il fier si incline a diestre, il patinadôr al va a diestre, se il fier si incline a çampe, il patinadôr al va a çampe.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Par tornâ ai nivei di energjie di prin, a àn di liberâ l’ecès di energjie che a àn cjapât de lûs.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Lu fasin emetint une piçule particule di lûs clamade "foton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: I sienziâts a clamin chest procès "emission stimolade di radiazions" parcè che i atoms a son stimolâts de lûs fuarte, causant la emission di un foton di lûs, e la lûs e je un tip di radiazion.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: La imagjin dopo e mostre i atoms che a emetin fotons. Logjic che i fotons inte realtât a son une vore plui piçui di chei tal dissen.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: I fotons a son ancjemò plui piçui de robe che e forme i atoms!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dopo centenârs di oris di funzionament, il filament inte lampadine ae fin si bruse e la lampadine no funzione plui.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Duncje dopo si à di cambiâ la lampadine. Si à di stâ atents cuant che si cambie une lampadine.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Prin di dut si à di studâ l’interutôr de lûs o distacâ il cabli.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Chest parcè che la eletricitât che e rive tal puartelampadine dulà che si cjate il toc metalic de lampadine e pues dâ une brute scosse eletriche se si tocje il puartelampadine o il toc metalic che al è ancjemò tacât al puartelampadine.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L’orghin principâl dal sisteme circolatori al è il cûr che al pompe il sanc.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Il sanc al jes dal cûr traviers tubuts clamâts arteriis e al torne al cûr traviers tubuts clamâts venis. I tubuts plui piçui si clamin capilârs.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I dincj dal triceratopi a jerin bogns di fruçâ no dome lis fueis, ma ancje rams e lidrîs une vore duris.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Cualchi sienziât al crôt che i triceratopis a mangjassin cicadis, che a son un gjenar di plante che al jere comun intal Cretacei.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Chestis plantis a somein a piçulis palmis cuntune corone di fueis uçadis e puntidis.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un triceratopi al podarès vê doprât il so bec fuart par discrotâ lis fueis prime di mangjâ il tronc.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Altris sienziâts a disin che chestis plantis a son une vore velenosis, duncje al è pôc probabil che cualchi dinosaur lis mangjàs, ancje se al dì di vuê il bradip e altris animâi come il pampagal (un dissendent dai dinosaurs) a puedin mangjâ fueis e pomis velenosis.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Cemût fasie la gravitât di Io a atraimi? Se tu fossis su la superficie di Io, tu pesaressis mancul di ce che tu pesis su la Tiere.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Une persone che e pese 200 liris (90 chilos) su la Tiere e pesarès cirche 36 liris (16 chilos) su Io. Duncje la gravitât, al è logjic, e atrai di mancul.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Il Soreli nol à une croste dulà che si pues stâ sù, come la Tiere. Dut il Soreli al è formât di gas, fûc e plasme.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Il gas al devente plui fin slontanantsi dal centri dal Soreli.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La part esterne che nô o viodìn cuant che o cjalin il Soreli e je clamade fotosfere, che al vûl dî “bale di lûs”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Cirche trê mil agns dopo, intal 1610, l’astronom talian Galileu Galilei al doprà un telescopi par osservâ che Venere al à des fasis, tant che la Lune.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Lis fasis a vegnin parcè che dome la bande di Venere (o de Lune) voltade viers il Soreli e je iluminade. Lis fasis di Venere a supuartin la teorie di Copernic che i planets a zirin ator dal Soreli.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Daspò, cualchi an dopo, intal 1639, un astronom inglês di non Jeremiah Horrocks al osservà un transit di Venere.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: La Ingletiere e veve gjoldût un periodi di pâs lunc dopo de riconcuiste dal Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Dut câs, tal 991 Ethelred al scugnì combati cuintri une flote vichinghe dabon plui grande di dutis, dopo di chê di Guthrum di un secul prime.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Cheste flote e jere condusude di Olaf Trygvasson, un norvegjês che al ambive di tornâ a cjapâ il so paîs de dominazion danese.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dopo lis primis sconfitis militârs, Ethelred al rivà a patizâ cun Olaf, che al tornà in Norvegje par provâ a cuistâ di gnûf il so ream cun risultâts no simpri positîfs.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Il hangeul, intal ûs popolâr di ogni dì, al è l’unic alfabet inventât di pueste. L’alfabet al fo inventât intal 1444 dulinvie dal ream dal re Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Il re Sejong al fo il cuart re de dinastie Joseon e al è un dai plui apreçâts.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: In origjin lui al veve clamât l’alfabet hangeul hunmin jeongeum, che al vûl dì “i suns corets par istruî la int”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: A son une vore di teoriis a rivuart di cemût che al è nassût il sanscrit. Une des teoriis e rivuarde une migrazion dai Arians di Ovest viers la Indie, dulà che a puartarin cun se la lôr lenghe.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Il sanscrit e je une lenghe antighe e si pues comparâ ae lenghe latine fevelade in Europe.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Il libri plui vecjo cognossût intal mont al è stât scrit in sanscrit. Dopo de compilazion des Upanishads, il sanscrit si sfantâ par colpe de jerarchie.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Il sanscrit e je une lenghe une vore complesse e siore, che e je servide come font par une vore di lenghis indianis modernis, propit come il latin che al è la font des lenghis europeanis tant che il francês e il spagnûl.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Cu la bataie pe France finide, la Gjermanie e scomençà a preparâsi par invadi la isule de Britanie.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: La Gjermanie i de al atac il non in codiç “Operazion leon di mâr”. La plui part des armis pesantis e des provisions dal esercit britanic a jerin ladis pierdudis cuant che al veve evacuât Dunkirk, cussì l’esercit al jere pluitost debil.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma la marine militâr britaniche e jere ancjemò tant plui fuarte di chê todescje (“Kriegsmarine”) e e varès podût distruzi cualsisei navîl di invasion mandât di chê altre bande dal Canâl inglês.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Dut câs, pocjis nâfs de marine britaniche a jerin stanziadis dongje des rotis di invasion plui probabilis stant che i amirâi a vevin pôre che i atacs aeris todescs lis mandassin sot.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Scomencìn cuntune spiegazion sui plans de Italie. In sostance la Italie e jere il “fradi piçul” di Gjermanie e Gjapon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: E veve un esercit e une marine plui debii, ancje se a vevin costruidis di pôc cuatri nâfs gnovis juste prin dal inizi de vuere.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: L’obietîf principâl de Italie a jerin lis nazions africanis. Par cjapâ chês nazions a varessin vût bisugne di une rampe di lanç pes trupis, cussì lis trupis a varessin podût navigâ di chê altre bande dal Mediterani e invadi la Afriche.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Par chel a vevin di liberâsi des basis e des nâfs britanichis intal Egjit. Sore di chestis azions, lis coraçadis talianis no vevin di fâ nuie altri.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Cumò pal Gjapon. Il Gjapon al è une nazion isule, tant che la Britanie.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sotmarins a son nâfs progjetadis par viazâ sot aghe, e par restâ li par un timp une vore lunc.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sotmarins a jerin doprâts inte prime e seconde vuere mondiâl. In chê volte a jerin une vore lents e a vevin une traietorie une vore limitade.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al inizi de vuere a viazavin dispès sul pêl de aghe, ma cuant che si tacà a svilupâ i radar e a fâju deventâ plui precîs i sotmarins a forin obleâts a lâ sot aghe par no fâsi viodi.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sotmarins todescs a jerin clamâts U-Boats. I todescs a jerin une vore brâfs a navigâ e manovrâ cui lôr sotmarins.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Par cause dal lôr sucès cui sotmarins, dopo la vuere nol jere afidabil che i todescs a ‘ndi vessin une vore.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sì! Il re Tutankhamon, cualchi volte clamât “re Tut” o “il frut re”, al è un dai rês dal antîc Egjit plui cognossûts in timp di vuê.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: In mût curiôs, nol jere considerât impuartant intai timps antîcs e nol fo regjistrât inte grant part des antighis listis dai rês.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Dut câs, la scuvierte de sô tombe intal 1922 lu fasè deventâ une celebritât. Cun dut che une vore di tombis a jerin stadis botinadis intal passât, cheste tombe e jere stade lassade in pratiche intate.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La grant part dai ogjets sepulîts cun Tutankhamon si son ben conservâts, cjapant dentri miârs di manufats fats cun metai preziôs e gjemis raris.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: La invenzion de ruede cui rais e veve rindût i cjars assîrs plui lizêrs, plui veloçs e miôr preparâts par cori plui svelts dai soldâts e di chei altris cjars.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Lis frecis des lôr balestris mortâls a podevin penetrâ la armadure dai soldâts rivâi. Cirche intal 1000 prin di Crist, i assîrs a introduserin la prime cavalarie.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Une cavalarie e je un esercit che al combat a cjaval. La siele no jere ancjemò stade inventade, cussì i cavalîrs assîrs a combatevin su lis gropis crotis dai lôr cjavai.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: O cognossìn une vore di politics, sienziâts, e artiscj grêcs. Forsit la persone plui cognossude di cheste culture al è Omêr, il lezendari poete vuarp, che al componè lis dôs oparis mestris de leterature greghe: i poemis Iliade e Odissee.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocle e Aristofan a son dramaturcs ancjemò popolârs e lis lôr oparis a son consideradis tra lis miôr oparis de leterature mondiâl.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un altri grêc famôs al è il matematic Pitagore, plui cognossût pal so famôs teoreme a rivuart des relazions dai lâts dal triangul retangul.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: A son svariadis stimis su cetantis personis che a fevelin Hindi. Si stime che e sedi tra la seconde e la cuarte lenghe plui fevelade al mont.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Il numar dai marilenghe al varie se si calcole i dialets leâts in mût plui strent o no.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Lis stimis a variin di 340 milions a 500 milions di locutôrs, e fin a 800 milions di personis a puedi capî la lenghe.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi e Urdu si somein tal vocabolari ma a son diviers inte scriture; intes conversazions di ogni dì i locutôrs des dôs lenghis par solit a puedin capîsi l’un cun chel altri.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Ator dal decim cuint secul, la Estonie setentrionâl e jere sot une grande influence culturâl de Gjermanie.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Cualchi munic todesc al voleve puartâ Diu plui dongje ai natîfs cussì al inventà la lenghe leterâl eston.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: E jere basade sul alfabet todesc e al fo zontât il caratar "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Cul passâ dal timp, une vore di peraulis che a jerin stadis prestadis dal todesc si son fondudis. Chest al fo l’inizi da la iluminazion.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Par tradizion, l’erêt al tron al leve dret intal esercit daspò di vê finide la scuele.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Dut câs, Carli al è lât ae universitât al Trinity College di Cambridge dulà che al à studiât antropologjie e archeologjie, e plui indenant storie, vuadagnânt un 2:2 (une lauree di seconde classe plui basse).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carli al è stât il prin membri de famee reâl britaniche a cjapâ la lauree.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turchie europeane (la Tracie orientâl o Rumelie inte penisule balcaniche) e cjape dentri il 3% de nazion.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Il teritori de Turchie al è lunc plui di 1.600 chilometris (1.000 miis) e larc 800 chilometris (500 miis), cuntune forme un pressapôc retangolâr.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Le aree de Turchie, cjapant dentri i lâts, e ocupe 783.562 chilometris cuadrâts (300.948 miis cuadradis), di chescj 755.688 chilometris cuadrâts (291.773 miis cuadradis) a son inte Asie ocidentâl e 23.764 chilometris cuadrâts (9.174 miis cuadradis) in Europe.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La sô superficie e rint la Turchie la 37esime nazion plui grande dal mont, e e je cirche de dimension de France metropolitane e dal Ream Unît insiemi.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: La Turchie e je circondade di mârs di trê bandis: il mâr Egjeu a Ovest, il Mâr Neri a Nord e il mâr Mediterani a Sud.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Il Lussemburc al à une storie lungje, ma la sô indipendence e scomence intal 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Des parts de Belgjiche di vuê a jerin part dal Lussemburc intal passât, ma a son deventadis belgjichis dopo la rivoluzion belgjiche dai agns 30 dal Votcent.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Il Lussemburc al à simpri provât a restâ une nazion neutrâl, ma al fo ocupât de Gjermanie sedi inte prime sedi inte seconde vuere mondiâl.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Intal 1957 il Lussemburc al deventà un membri fondadôr de organizazion che vuê e je cognossude come Union Europeane.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Il Drukgyal Dzong al è une fuartece in ruvine e un munistîr budist inte part plui alte dal distret di Paro (intal paîs di Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Si dîs che intal 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel al vedi creât la fuartece par comemorâ la sô vitorie cuintri lis fuarcis tibetanis e mongulis.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Intal 1951 un fûc al fasè in mût che al restàs dome cualchi relit dal Drukgyal Dzong, come la imagjin di Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Daspò dal fûc, la fuartece e je stade conservade e protete, restant une des plui sensazionâls atrazions dal Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Intal secul decim otâf la Camboze si cjatà strucade tra doi vicins potents, la Tailande e il Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I tailandês a invaderin la Camboze une vore di voltis intal secul decim otâf e intal 1772 a sdrumarin Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Intai ultins agns dal secul decim otâf ancje i vietnamitis a invaderin la Camboze.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Il disevot par cent dai venezuelans a son disocupâts, e la plui part di chei che a lavorin a son tal cjamp de economie somerzude.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Doi tierçs dai venezuelans che a lavorin lu fasin intal setôr dai servizis, cuasi un cuart al lavore inte industrie e un cuint inte agriculture.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Une industrie impuartante par i venezuelans al è il petroli, dulà che il stât al è un espuartadôr net, ancje se dome l’un par cent al lavore inte industrie dal petroli.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Intai prins timps de indipendence nazionâl, i esperts dai orts botanics di Singapôr a àn judât a trasformâ la isule intune citât di zardins tropicâi.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Intal 1981 Vanda Miss Joaquim, une orchidee ibride, e je stade sielte come rose nazionâl de nazion.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ogni an viers Otubar scuasit 1,5 milions di erbivars a viazin viers lis planuris meridionâls, traviersant il flum Mara, des culinis a Nord par lis ploiis.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E daspò a tornin indaûr al Nord passant pal Ovest, traviersant di gnûf il flum Mara, daspò des ploiis di Avrîl.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: La regjon dal Serengeti e conten il parc nazionâl dal Serengeti, la aree protete Ngorongoro e la risierve di cjace Maswa in Tanzanie e la risierve nazionâl Maasai Mara tal Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Par imparâ a creâ media interatîfs a coventin abilitâts tradizionâls e convenzionâls, cussì come struments paronâts intes classis interativis (creâ storyboard, montaç audio e video, contâ storiis e vie indenant)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Il progjetâ in mût interatîf al domande di rivalutâ lis propriis convinzions in cont de produzion dai media e imparâ a pensâ in mûts no lineârs.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Il progjet interatîf al domande che i components di un progjet a sedin colegâts l’un cun chel altri, ma ancje che a vedin un sens come entitâts separadis.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Il svantaç dai obietîfs cul zoom al è che la complessitât focâl e il numar dai elements des lints domandâts par rivâ a une varietât di lungjecis focâls a son plui grancj di chei dai obietîfs a focâl fisse.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chest al devente un probleme simpri plui piçul stant che i produtôrs di lints a stan rivant a nivei plui alts di produzion.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Chest al à permetût ai obietîfs zoom di otignî imagjins di cualitât comparabile cun chê otignude cu lis lints cun lungjece focâl fisse.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un altri svantaç dai obietîfs cul zoom al è che la viertidure massime (la velocitât) des lints par solit e je plui basse.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Chest al rint i obietîfs cul zoom economics plui dificii di doprâ in cundizions di lûs basse e cence il lamp.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un dai problemis plui comuns cuant che si cîr di convertî un film in DVD al è l’overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: La plui part des televisions a son fatis par sodisfâ il grant public.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Par chest, dut ce che si viôt par television al à i ôrs taiâts, sot, sore e tai lâts in bande.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Chest par fâ in mût che la imagjin e cjapi dut il schermi, une operazion che par inglês si clame “overscan”.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Pecjât che, cuant che si fâs un DVD, al è cuasi sigûr i siei ôrs a vegnin taiâts e, se il filmât al veve i sottitui masse dongje al ôr sot, chescj no si viodaran in maniere integrâl.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Il cjistiel medievâl tradizionâl al ispire la imagjinazion di une vore di timp, evocant imagjins di gjostris, trataments e cavalarie arturiane.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ancje tal mieç des ruvinis vieris di mil agns al è facil rivocâ suns e odôrs di bataiis aromai lontanis, par sintî cuasi il talpetament dai çucui sui cogui e l’odôr de pôre che e vignive sù dai fonts des presons.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma la nestre imagjinazion ise basade su la realtât? Prin di dut, parcè sono stâts costruîts i cjistiei? Cemût sono stâts progjetâts e fats sù?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipic dal periodi, il cjistiel Kirby Muxloe al è plui une cjase fortificade che no un vêr cjistiel.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: I siei larcs barcons di veri e mûrs sutîi no varessin podût resisti a atacs decîs par tant timp.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Intai agns 80 dal Cuatricent, cuant che Lord Hastings al veve scomençât la sô costruzion, la nazion e jere plui o mancul pacifiche e une difese e coventave dome cuintri piçulis bandis di ladrons vagabonts.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Il belançament dal podê al jere un sistemi dulà che lis nazions europeanis a cirivin di mantignî la sovranitât di ducj i stâts europeans.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Il concet al jere chel che dutis lis nazions europeanis a vevin di prevignî che une nazion e deventàs potente, e duncje i guviers nazionâi a cambiavin dispès lis lôr aleancis par mantignî il belançament.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La vuere di sucession spagnole e fo la prime vuere dulà che il probleme centrâl al jere il belançament dal podê.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Chest al marcà un cambiament impuartant, viodût che i podês europeans no vevin plui il rimpin che a fossin vueris di religjon. Cussì la Vuere dai trente agns e sarès stade la ultime vuere a jessi classificade come vuere religjose.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Il templi di Artemide a Efeso al fo sdrumât ai 21 di Lui dal 356 p.d.C. cuntun incendi dolôs fat di Erostrato.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Daûr de storie, la sô motivazion e jere la fame a cualsisei cost. I abitants di Efeso, disdegnâts, a anunziarin che il non di Erostrato nol sarês mai stât regjistrât.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Il storic grêc Strabon plui tart al cjapà note dal non, che al è cemût che lu savìn vuê. Il templi al fo sdrumât inte stesse gnot che al nasseve Alessandri il Grant.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alessandri, cuant che al jere re, al ufrì di paiâ par tornâ a fâ sù il templi, ma la sô ufierte e fo dineade. Plui tart, dopo la muart di Alessandri, il templi al fo ricostruît intal 323 prin di Crist.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Siguriti di vê lis mans plui rilassadis pussibil intant che tu batis dutis lis notis intal mût corêt - prove ancje a no fâ masse moviments forescj cui dêts.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Cussì tu ti stracarâs il mancul pussibil. Visiti che nol covente bati sui tascj cuntune vore di fuarce par dâ plui volum come tal piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Su la armoniche, par vê plui volum, si dopre i comedons con plui pression o velocitât.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Il misticisim al è la ricercje di une comunion o identitât cuntune realtât ultime, o cussience cussiente di chê realtât, une divinitât, une veretât spirituâl o un Diu.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Il crodint al cîr une esperience direte, une intuizion, o une vision inte realtât divine/il diu o i dius.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I dissepui a van daûr cierts mûts di vivi, o pratichis che a dovaressin nudrî chês esperiencis.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Il misticisim si pues diferenziâlu di altris formis di crodince religjose e adorazion pe sô enfasi su la esperience personâl direte di un stât particolâr di cussience, in particolâr chês di caratar cuiet, profont, beât o ancje estatic.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Il sikhisim e je une religjon dal subcontinent indian. E a vude origjine inte regjon dal Punjab tal secul decim cuint cu la secession di une sete dentri de tradizion indù.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: I sikh a considerin la lôr fede come une religjon separade dal induisim ancje se a ricognossin lis sôs lidrîs e tradizions indù.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikh a clamin la lôr religjon Gurmat, che in punjabi al vûl dî “la vie dal guru”. Il guru al è un aspiet fondamentâl di dutis lis religjons indianis, ma intal sikhisim al à cjapade une impuartance che e je il nucli des crodincis sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La religjon e fo fondade intal secul decim cuint di Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Al fo seguît in sucession di altris nûf gurus.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Dut câs, intal Jugn dal 1956 lis promessis di Krushchev a son stadis metudis ae prove cuant che lis rivoltis in Polonie, dulà che i lavoradôrs a protestavin cuintri la penurie di mangjâ e i tais ae paie, a son deventadis une proteste gjenerâl cuintri il comunisim.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ancje se ae fin Krushchev al veve mandât i cjârs armâts par tornâ a puartâ l’ordin, al à concedût cualchi richieste economiche e acetât di nomenâ il popolâr Wladyslaw Gomulka come gnûf prin ministri.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La civiltât de val dal Indo e jere une civiltât de Ete dal bronç intal Nordovest dal subcontinent indian che e cjapave dentri la plui part dal Pakistan di vuê e cualchi altre regjon dal Nordovest de Indie e dal Nordest dal Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civiltât e florì intai bacins dal flum Indo di dulà che al derive il sô non.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ancje se cualchi studiôs al specule che stant che la civiltât e esisteve ancje intal bacin dal flum Sarasvati, che cumò al è sut, al sarès apropriât clamâle la civiltât Indo-Sarasvati, invezit cualchidun la clame civiltât harappane, di Harappa, il prin dai sîts sgjavât intai agns vincj dal Nûfcent.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La nature militariste dal imperi roman e judà intal svilup dai progrès de medisine.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: L’imperadôr August al scomençà a reclutâ miedis e parfin a formâ il prin cuarp roman di medisine par doprâlu dopo des bataiis.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurcs a vevin une cognossince di diviers sedatîfs cjapant dentri la morfine gjavade fûr dai estrats des semencis dai papavars e la scopolamine des semencis de jerbe di Sante Polonie.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: A deventarin esperts de amputazion par salvâ i pazients de gangrene come ancje dai laç emostatics e pinzis pes arteriis par fermâ il flus dal sanc.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Par une vore di secui l’imperi roman al puartà a grandis concuistis intal cjamp de medisine e al formà la plui part des cognossincis che o vin vuê.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L’origami di Pureland al è un origami cu la restrizion che si pues fâ dome une plee par volte, pleis plui complessis come la plee contrarie no son permetudis, e dutis lis pleis a àn posizions claris.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Al è stât svilupât di John Smith intai agns 70 dal Nûfcent par judâ i pleadôrs cence esperience o chei cun abilitâts motoriis limitadis.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: I fruts a svilupin une cussience de raze e dai stereotips raziâi une vore adore e chescj stereotips raziâi a influencin il compuartament.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Par esempli, i fruts che si identifichin cuntune minorance raziâl che e ven stereotipade come no brave a scuele a tendin a no lâ ben a scuele cuant che a imparin chel stereotip associât ae lôr raze.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace al è il tierç sît internet plui doprât tai Stâts Unîts e ore presint al conte 54 milions di profîi.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Chescj sîts internet a àn cjapât tante atenzion, soredut intal ambit de istruzion.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: A son aspiets positîfs in chescj sîts internet, come par esempli podê impuestâ cun facilitât une pagjine di classe che e pues includi blogs, filmâts, fotografiis e altris carateristichis.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Si pues rivâ in cheste pagjine furnint dome la direzion internet, un procediment facil di visâsi e di scrivi par ducj chei students che a àn dificoltât a doprâ la tastiere o cu la abilitât di scrivi.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: E pues jessi personalizade par leile cun facilitât e cui colôrs che si vuelin.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Il disturp dal deficit di atenzion “e je une sindrome neurologjiche dulà che i classics trê sintoms che la definissin a cjapin dentri la impulsivitât, la facilitât ae distrazion e la iperativitât o ecès di energjie”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: No je une disabilitât dal aprendiment, al è un disturp dal aprendiment che "al cjape dal 3 al 5 par cent di ducj i fruts, forsit fintremai 2 milions di fruts americans".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: I fruts cun ADD a fasin une vore di fadie a concentrâsi su robis come il lavôr di scuele, ma a puedin concentrâsi su lis robis che ju divertissin come i zûcs o cjalâ i lôr cartons animâts preferîts o scrivi frasis cence puntuazion.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Chescj fruts a tendin a finî intune vore di problemis, parcè che “a adotin compuartaments pericolôs, si cjapin dentri des barufis e a sfidin la autoritât” par stimolâ il cerviel, stant che il lôr cerviel no si pues stimolâ cun metodis normâi.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L’ADD al colpîs lis relazions cun chei altris coetanis parcè che chei altris fruts no rivin a capî parcè che lôr si compuartin in chel mût o parcè che a scrivin in chel mût o che il lôr nivel di maturitât al è diferent.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Come la abilitât di otignî cognossince e di imparâ e cambie intal mût dite parsore il tas di base in cui la cognossince e je otignude a cambie.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Il metodi par otignî informazions al jere diferent. La pression no stave plui dentri dal ricuart individuâl, ma la abilitât di ricuardâ un test e deventave plui une atenzion.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: In pratiche il Rinassiment al puartà cambiaments impuartants inte metodiche didatiche e inte difusion de cognossince.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Al contrari di altris primâts, i ominidis no doprin plui lis mans par movisi o par puartâ il pês o par niçulâsi di un arbul a chel altri.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Lis mans e i pîts dal simpanzè a son simii intes dimensions e lungjece, rifletint l’ûs des mans par puartâ il pês cjaminant su lis aìnis.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La man umane e je plui curte dal pît, cun falangjis plui dretis.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: I vues fossii des mans di doi a trê milions di agns indaûr a palesin chest mudament inte specializazion de man de locomozion ae manipolazion.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Cualchidun al crôt che sperimentâ siums lustris indots in mût artificiâl avonde dispès al pues scunî une vore.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Il motîf principâl di chest fenomen al è il risultât dai siums lustris che a ingrandissin il periodi di timp tra lis fasis REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Cun mancul fasis REM par gnot, chest stât dulà che si sperimente il sium vêr e il cuarp al recupere, al devente avonde râr tant di deventâ un probleme.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Chest al scunîs come se tu ti alçâssis ogni vinç o trente minuts par cjalâ la TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L’efiet al dipent di trop spes che il cerviel al prove a vê siums lustris ogni gnot.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Lis robis no lerin ben pai talians in Afriche setentrionâl za dal imprin. Dentri di une setemane dopo de declarazion di vuere di bande de Italie dai 10 di Jugn 1940, il diesim prin reziment britanic dai ussars al veve cuistât il fuart Capuzzo in Libie.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Intune vuaite a Est di Bardie, i britanics a cjaparin il gjenerâl Lastucci, inzegnîr sorecjâf de Diesime armade taliane.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ai 28 di Jugn, il maressial Italo Balbo, governadôr gjenerâl de Libie e probabil sucessôr di Mussolini, al fo copât di fûc amì intant che al stave cjapant tiere a Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Il moderni sport de scherme si zuie a tancj nivei, dai students che a imparin ae universitât ai professioniscj e i competidôrs olimpics.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Il sport si zuie plui di dut in forme di duel, un schermidôr che al duele cuntun altri.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Il golf al è un zûc dulà che i zuiadôrs a doprin des macis par mandâ des balis intes busis.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Dulinvie di une partide regolâr si zuin disevot busis, cui zuiadôrs che par solit a scomencin de prime buse dal percors e a finissin ae decime otave buse.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Il zuiadôr che al dopre mancul colps, o vongoladis de mace, par completâ il percors al vinç.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Il zûc si zuie su la jerbe, e la jerbe ator des busis e ven seade plui curte e e je clamade il vert.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Forsit il tip plui comun di turisim al è chel che la plui part de int e lee al viazâ: il turisim ricreatîf.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Chest al è cuant che la int a va intun lûc une vore diferent de sô vite cuotidiane par rilassâsi e divertîsi.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Lis splazis, i parcs a teme e i camping a son dispès i lûcs plui comuns frecuentâts dai turiscj ricreatîfs.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Se l’obietîf de visite intun lûc particolâr al è di cognossi la sô storie e culture alore chest tip di turisim al è cognossût come turisim culturâl.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: I turiscj a puedin visitâ diviersis atrazions di une particolâr Stât o a puedin sielzi di concentrâsi dome suntune regjon.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: I colonialiscj, viodude cheste ativitât, a clamarin i rinfuarçs.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Lis trupis che a rinfuarçavin lis posizions avanzadis a includevin il prin e il tierç reziment New Hampshire di 200 oms, sot i colonei John Stark e James Reed (ducj i doi daspò a deventarin gjenerâi).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: I oms di Stark a cjaparin posizion dilunc de cente inte ultime part a Nord de posizion dai colonialiscj.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Cuant che la basse maree e vierzè un spazi dilunc dal flum Mystic, dilunc de part Nordest de penisule, lôr a slungjarin ae svelte la cente cuntun curt mûr di piere viers la estremitât a Nord dongje la rive dal mâr suntune piçule splaze.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark a meterin un pâl di cirche 100 pîts (30 m) denant de cente e a ordenarin di no fâ faiar fin che i soldâts regolârs no lu vessin passât.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Il plan american al faseve afidament sul lançâ dai atacs coordenâts di trê direzions diviersis.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Il gjenerâl John Cadwalder al varès lançât un atac diversîf cuintri la guarnigjon inglese a Bordentown, par blocâ cualsisei rinfuarç.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Il gjenerâl James Ewing al varès puartât 700 milizians di là dal flum a Trenton Ferry, concuistant il puint sul Assunpink Creek e impedint a cualsisei trupe nemie di scjampâ.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La principâl fuarce di atac di 2.400 oms e varès traviersât il flum nûf miis a Nord di Trenton, e daspò si sarès dividude in doi grups, un sot Greene e un sot Sullivan, par lançâ un atac prin dal cricâ dì.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Cul cambiament da la corse di un cuart di mie a chê di mieze mie, la velocitât e je deventade mancul impuartante e la resistence e je deventade une necessitât assolude.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Clâr che un coridôr de mieze mie di prime classe, un om che al pues bati i doi minûts, al devi vê un biel pocje di velocitât, ma la resistence e va coltivade a ducj i coscj.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Cualchi corse tal cjamp dulinvie pal Invier, cumbinade cul alenament in palestre pe part parsore dal cuarp, e je la miôr preparazion pe stagjon di corse.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Lis buinis pratichis nutrizionâls di bessolis no puedin gjenerâ lis plui altis prestazions, ma a puedin influençâ une vore il benstâ gjenerâl dai zovins atletis.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantignî un belançament di energjie salutâr, praticâ dai abits di idratazion eficaçs, e capî i diviers aspiets des pratichis di integrazion a puedin judâ i atletis a miorâ la prestazion e aumentâ il lôr gjoldiment dal sport.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La mieze maratone e je un sport plui o mancul economic; dut câs, a son dai malintindiment a rivuart dai pocs tocs di furniment necessaris par partecipâ.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: I prodots si puedin comprâ secont de necessitât, ma la plui part a varan in efiets un piçul impat o nissun su la prestazion.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: I atletis a puedin sintî che a preferissin un prodot ancje se nol puarte un vêr benefici.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L’atom si pues considerâ un dai modons fondamentâi di dute la materie.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Al è une entitât une vore complesse che e consist, secont un model di Bohr semplificât, di un nucli centrâl cui eletrons che a orbitin ator, in cualchi maniere simil ai planets che a orbitin ator dal Soreli - viôt la figure 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Il nucli al consist di dôs particulis - neutrons e protons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: I protons a àn une cjarie eletriche positive invezit i neutrons no àn cjarie. I eletrons a àn cjarie eletriche negative.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Par controlâ la vitime, tu âs prime di analizâ la sene par garantî la tô sigurece.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Tu âs di osservâ la posizion de vitime cuant che tu ti svicinis a jê o a lui e cualsisei campanel di alarme automatic.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Se tu ti fasis mâl cirint di judâ, tu finissis par coventâ dome par fâ lâ in piês lis robis.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Il studi al à scuviert che la depression, la pôre e il catastrofisim si inframetin te relazion tra il dolôr e la disabilitât par chei che a patissin dolôrs inte basse schene.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Dome i efiets dal catastrofisim, no la depression e pôre, a condizionavin lis sessions setemanâls organizadis e regolârs di ativitât fisiche.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
