text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La viste, o capacitât di viodi e dipent dai orghins sensoriâi dal sistemi visîf o voi.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: A son une vore di diviersis costruzions di voi, che a variin di complessitât a seconde dai bisugns dal organisim.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Lis diferentis costruzions a àn capacitâts diferentis, a son sensibilis a lungjecis di onde diferentis e a àn diferents grâts di finece, cun di plui a domandi procediments diferents par dâ un sens ai stimui e numars diferents par lavorâ in mût otimâl.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Une popolazion e je l’insiemi di organisims di une specie particolâr dentri di une cierte aree gjeografiche.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Cuant che ducj i individuis intune popolazion a son compagns par une particolâr carateristiche fenotipiche, a son cognossûts come monomorfics.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Cuant che i individuis a mostrin diviersis variants di une carateristiche particolâr a son polimorfics.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ancje lis coloniis des furmiis legjonariis a marcjin e a nidifichin in fasis diferentis.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Ognidune di chestis scorsadis o marcjis nomadichis e dure cirche 17 dîs.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Ce ise une celule? La peraule celule e rive de peraule latine “cella”, che e significhe “piçule stanzie”, e e je stade inventade di un microscopist che al osservave la struture dal sûr.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La celule e je la unitât di base di dutis lis creaturis vivents, e ducj i organisims a son componûts di une o plui celulis.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Lis celulis a son cussì essenziâls e impuartants pal studi de vite, in efiets, che a son clamadis spes “i modons de vite”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Il sisteme gnervôs al manten la omeostasi inviant al gnerf l’impuls vie pal cuarp par mantignî il flus dal sanc cence fastidis.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Chescj impuls dal gnerf si puedin inviâ cussì ae svelte vie pal cuarp che al jude a mantignî il cuarp al sigûr di potenziâls menacis.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Lis bissebovis a colpissin une aree piçule comparadis cun altris burascjis violentis, ma a puedin distruzi dut su la lôr strade.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Chestis burascjis mostruosis a àn aiar fin a 480 chilometris par ore (133 m/s; 300 miis par ore).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Dut câs, i prins vêrs telescopis a son stâts fats in Europe ae fin dal 16m secul.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Chescj telescopis a dopravin un cumbinazion di dôs lints par fâ someâ i ogjets lontans plui vicins e grancj.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: I animâi a son fats di une vore di celulis. A mangjin robis e lis digjerissin dentri. La plui part dai animâi e pues movisi.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: I animâi si cjatin in dute la tiere. A sgarfin intal teren, a nadin intai oceans e a svolin intal cîl.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Une celule e je la unitât struturâl e funzionâl plui piçule di un organisim (creature) vivent.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: La peraule celule e ven de peraule latine cella che e significhe piçule stanzie.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Se tu cjalis lis creaturis vivents sot di un microscopi, tu viodarâs che a son fatis di piçui cuadrâts o balis.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biolic de Ingletiere, cul microscopi al viodè piçui cuadrâts intal sûr.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: A someavin stanziis. Al fo la prime persone a osservâ celulis muartis
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I elements e lis sostancis a puedin passâ di un stât a chel altri cence cambiâ.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L’azot come gas al à ancjemò lis stessis proprietâts dal azot licuit. Il stât licuit al è plui penç, ma lis moleculis a son simpri compagnis.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: La aghe e je un altri esempli. Il compuest aghe al è fat di doi atoms di idrogjen e un atom di ossigjen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Che e sedi gas, licuide o solide e à simpri la stesse struture molecolâr.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Ancje se il so stât fisic al pues cambiâ, il so stât chimic al reste compagn.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Il timp al è alc che nus circonde, e al influìs su dut ce che o fasìn, ma al è dificil di capî.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Il timp al è stât studiât dai studiôs de religjon, de filosofie e de sience par miârs di agns.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: O percepìn il timp come une serie di events che a passin dal futûr traviers dal presint fin al passât.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Il timp al è ancje il mût che o vin di comparâ la durade (lungjece) dai events.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Si pues marcjâ il passâ dal timp di bessôi cul osservâ la ripetizion di un event ciclic. Un event ciclic al è alc che al sucêt plui e plui voltis in mût regolâr.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: I ordenadôrs di vuê a son doprâts par manipolâ fotografiis e videos.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animazions sofisticadis si puedin meti dongje cui ordenadôrs, e chest gjenar di animazion si lu dopre simpri di plui te television e tai films.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La musiche e ven dispès regjistrade doprant dai ordenadôrs sofisticâts par processà e misturâ insiemi i suns.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Par un lunc periodi di timp dulinvie dai secui decim novesim e vincjesim, si crodeve che i prins abitants de Gnove Zelande a fossin il popul Maori, che a cjaçavin uciei zigants clamâts moa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Chê volte la teorie e veve stabilît la idee che il popul Maori al jere migrât de Polinesie cuntune grande flote e al veve cjapât la Gnove Zelande dai Moriori, stabilint une societât agricule.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Dut câs, gnovis provis a sugjerissin che i Moriori a fossin un grup di Maori de tiereferme che al jere migrât de Gnove Zelande aes isulis Chatham, disvilupant une lôr culture distintive e pacifiche.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: E jere ancjemò une altre tribù su lis isulis Chatham e chescj a jerin i Maori che a jerin migrâts lontan de Gnove Zelande.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Lôr stes si clamavin Moriori, a capitarin un pocjis di schermadis e ae fin, i Moriori a vignirin parâts vie
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Individuis che a jerin stâts coinvolts par diviers decenis nus judavin a apreçâ i nestris ponts di fuarce e lis passions intant che a valutavin cun scletece lis dificoltâts e parfin i faliments.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Intant che o scoltavin lis personis condividi lis lôr storiis individuâls, familiârs e organizativis, o acuisivin informazions preziosis sul passât e su cualchidune des personalitâts che a àn influençât ben o mâl la culture de organizazion.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Là che capî la storie di une persone nol prossume la comprension de culture, almancul al jude lis personis a otignî un sens di dulà che si colochin inte storie de organizazion.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Intant che a valutin i sucès e a deventin cussients dai faliments, i individuis e il complès des personis che a partecipin a scuvierzin in mût plui profont i valôrs, la mission e lis fuarcis motoriis de organizazion.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Par esempli, ricuardâ i câs passâts di compuartaments imprenditoriâls e i sucès risultâts al à judât lis personis a jessi viertis ai gnûfs cambiaments e a gnovis direzions pe glesie locâl.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Chestis storiis di sucès a àn diminuît la pôre dal cambiament, creant inclinazions positivis viers il cambiament intal futûr.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: I modei dal pinsîr convergjent a son tecnichis par risolvi problemis che a metin adun ideis o ambits diviers par cjatâ une soluzion.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Chest pinsîr si fonde sore sveltece, logjiche e precision, e ancje identificazion dai fats, aplicazion di tecnichis preesistentis e racuelte di informazions.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Il fatôr plui impuartant di chest pinsîr al è che la rispueste juste e je nome une. Si pues pensâ nome a dôs rispuestis, ven a stai juste o sbaliade.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Chest gjenar di pinsîr al è associât a ciertis proceduris standard o dal ambit sientific.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Lis personis che a àn chest gjenar di pinsîr a àn un mût di pensâ logjic, a rivin a memorizâ modei, risolvi problemis e lavorâ a provis sientifichis.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: I umans a son di un biel toc la specie cun plui talent intal lei lis ments di chei altris.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Chest al significhe che o sin bogns di previodi cun sucès ce che chei altris umans a percepissin, a intindin, a crodin, a san o desiderin.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Jenfri chestis abilitâts, capî lis intenzions di chei altris al è fondamentâl. Nus permet di risolvi lis pussibilis ambiguitâts des azions fisichis.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Par esempli, se tu vessis di viodi cualchidun che al romp la barconete di une machine, in mût probabil tu assumaressis che al stâ cirînt di robâ la auto di un scognossût.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Al varès di jessi judicât in mût diviers se al ves pierdudis lis clâfs e e fos la sô auto chê che al jere daûr a scassinâ.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: La MRI e je basade suntun fenomen fisic clamât risonance magnetiche nucleâr (RMN), che e je stade scuvierte intai agns 30 dal Nûfcent di Felix Bloch (che al lavorave ae Universitât di Stanford) e Edward Purcell (de Universitât di Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: In cheste risonance il cjamp magnetic e lis ondis radio a fasin in mût che i atoms a dedin fûr piçui segnâi radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Intal an 1970 Raymond Damadian, dotôr in medisine e ricercjadôr sientific, al à scuviert lis basis par doprâ l’imaging a risonance magnetiche tant che imprest pes diagnosis medichis.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Cuatri agns dopo al fo ricognossût un brevet, che al jere il prin brevet dal mont dât intal cjamp dal MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Intal 1977 il dotôr Damadian al completave la costruzion dal prin scansionadôr MRI par “dut il cuarp”, che al à clamât l’“Indomabil”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicazion asincrone e incoragje il timp pe riflession e la reazion viers chei altris.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: E permet ai students la abilitât di lavorâ al lôr ritmi e controlâ il ritmi des informazions istrutivis.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Cun di plui a son mancul restrizions di timp cu la pussibilitât di oris di lavôr flessibilis. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L’ûs di Internet e dal World Wide Web al permet ai students di vê acès aes informazions in cualsisei moment.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I students a puedin ancje fâ domandis ai istrutôrs in ogni moment de zornade e spietâsi une rispueste plui o mancul rapide, pluitost che spietâ fin al sucessîf incuintri di persone.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: La nestre esperience atuâl cun dut il fâ-di-bessôi e i programs televisîfs basâts sul aprendiment e che a presentin informazions e ilustre chest pont.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Come dit parsore, ancje se la peraule “eschimês” e je ancjemò acetade intai Stâts Unîts, e je considerade ofensive par tantis popolazions artichis fûr dai Stâts Unîts, soredut in Canadà.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ogni tren al à tant la MetroPlus che lis carocis Metro; lis carocis MetroPlus a son simpri ae fin dal tren plui dongje a Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Puartâ par altris: no lassâ mai lis borsis fûr di viste, in mût particolâr cuant che si traviersin i confins internazionâi.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: A cjase, a cause di cheste esposizion costante ai bateris locâi, al è une vore probabil che tu sedis za imun a lôr.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Cun di plui, intai climis cjalts i bateris a cressin plui ae svelte e a sorevivin plui a lunc fûr dal cuarp.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Di chi lis plaiis de sindrome de panze di Delhi, la maledizion dal faraon, la vendete di Montezuma e i lôr tancj amîs.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Come cui problemis respiratoris intai climis plui frêts, problemis intestinâi intai climis cjalts a son une vore comuns e inte plui part dai câs a son avonde fastidiôs ma no pardabon pericolôs.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Se tu viazis intune nazion daûr a svilupâsi pe prime volte (o intune gnove part dal mont) no sta sotvalutâ il potenziâl traume culturâl.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Une vore di viazadôrs abii e stabii a son stâts stramontâts de novitât dal viaç intal mont daûr a svilupâsi, dulà che une vore di piçui justaments culturâi a puedin sumâsi ae svelte.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: In particolâr intai prins dîs, considere di dissipâ in hotel, mangjâ e servizis di stîl e cualitât ocidentâl par judâti a ambientâti.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: No sta durmî su materassins o tapêts par tiere in areis dulà che no tu cognossis la faune locâl.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Se tu âs intenzion di fâ camping, puarte une brande o une amache par tignîti lontan di sarpints, sgarpions e simii.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Jemple la cjase cuntun cafè siôr di matine e une camamile rilassante di gnot.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Cuant che tu stâs in vacance a cjase, tu âs il timp di figotâti e cjapâti cualchi minût in plui par preparâti cualchi alc di speciâl.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Se tu ti sintis plui aventurôs, cjape la ocasion par preparâti un struc o messedâ dai frulâts:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: forsit tu scuvierzarâs une bevande semplice che tu puedis fâ par gulizion cuant che tu tornis al to dran dran cuotidian.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se tu vivis intune citât cuntune culture di bevi varie, va in bar e pub intai cuartîrs che no tu frecuentis.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Par chei che no àn familiaritât cul zergon medic, lis peraulis infetîf e epidemic a àn significâts distints.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Une malatie infetive e je une causionade di patogjens, come virus, bateris, foncs o altris parasits.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Une malatie epidemiche e je une malatie che e je facilmentri trasmissibile stant intes vicinancis di une persone infete.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Une vore di guviers a domandin che i visitadôrs che a jentrin, o i residents che a jessin des lôr nazions a sedin vacinâts par un spetri di malatiis.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Chescj recuisîts spes a puedin dipendi di ce nazions che un viazadôr al à visitât o al intint visitâ.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un dai elements di fuarce de citât di Charlotte, in North Carolina, e je la sô bondance di opzions di prime sielte pes fameis.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: I residents vignûts di altris zonis a nomenin dispès lis cundizions otimâls pes fameis tant che il motîf primari che a son lâts a stâ culì, e tancj visitadôrs a cjatin la citât une vore gjoldibile cui fruts.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Tai ultins vincj agns lis opzions pai fruts tal centri di Charlotte a son cressudis in mût esponenziâl.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: In gjenar i taxis a Charlotte no son doprâts des fameis, ancje se in ciertis situazions a puedin jessi utii.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Se i passizîrs a son plui di doi, si paie un suplement, duncje cheste sielte e pues jessi une vore plui cjare di ce che al covente.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: La Antartide e je il puest plui frêt de Tiere e e circonde il Pôl Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Lis visitis turistichis a son costosis, a domandin une buine forme fisiche, a puedin davuelzisi dome in Istât, di Novembar a Fevrâr e a son pe plui part limitadis ae penisule, aes isulis e al Mâr di Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un pâr di miârs di impleâts a vivin chi di Istât in cirche cuatri dozenis di basis par plui in chês zonis; une piçule part si ferme par dut l'Invier.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: La Antartide indentri e je un altiplan desolât cuviert di 2-3 chilometris di glaç.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Visitis aeriis specialistichis ocasionâls a van indentri, par fâ alpinisim o par rivâ al Pôl, che al à une grande base.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: La Traviersade (clamade ancje Autostrade) dal Pôl Sud e je une trate di 1600 chilometris che e va de stazion di McMurdo tal mâr di Ross fin al Pôl.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: E je fate di nêf une vore fisse dulà che i sclapons a son jemplâts e segnâts cun bandieris. Nome tratôrs speciâi che a traspuartin slitis cun carburant e provisions a puedin traviersâle.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Chestis no son tant agjilis duncje la trate e fâs une lungje deviazion ator des monts Transantartichis par rivâ tal altiplan.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: La cause plui comun dai incidents in Invier a son lis stradis e i listons (marcjepîts) sbrissôs, e in particolâr i scjalins.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: A coventin al minim scarpis cun suelis adatis. Lis scarpis estivis a son masse sbrissotis sul glaç e la nêf, ma parfin cierts scarpons invernâi a son carents.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Il batistrade al varès di vê almancul cinc milimetris (1/5 di once) di spessôr o plui, e il materiâl al varès di restâ tenar ancje cun temperaduris fredis.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Cierts scarpons a àn glacins incorporâts e pes cundizions plui sbrissotis a esistin glacins di zontâ nome tal talon o ancje tes suelis, adats ae plui part des scarpis e dai scarpons.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: I tacs a varessin di jessi bas e larcs. Spes tes stradis e tai trois si bute savalon, glerein o sâl (clorûr di calci) par miorâ la aderence.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Lis lavinis no son une anomalie: lis clevis ripidis a puedin tignî nome une cierte cuantitât di nêf e i volums in soreplui a vegnin jù tant che lavinis.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Il probleme al è che la nêf e je tacadice, duncje ai covente une lescje par vignî jù, e un pocje di nêf che e cole e pues fâ di lescjament pal rest.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: A voltis il lescjament al è il soreli che al scjalde la nêf, altris voltis al è altre nêf che e cole, altris ancjemò a son altris events naturâi, spes a son i oms.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: La bissebove e je une colone voltizant di aiar a pression une vore basse che e cjape dentri e e sburte in sù l’aiar dulintor.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: A produsin aiar fuart (spes a 100-200 miis a la ore) e a puedin tirâ sù in tal aiar ogjets pesants e puartâju indenant intant che la bissebove si môf.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: A scomencin tant che pleris che a vegnin jù dai nûi di burlaç e a deventin “bissebovis” cuant che a tocjin la tiere.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I distributôrs di VPN personâls (rêts privadis virtuâls) a son une otime maniere par eludi sedi la censure politiche sedi il gjeofiltrament comerciâl dal IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: A son miôr dai web proxy par plui resons: a fasin deviâ dut il trafic internet, no dome chel http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Di solit a ufrissin une largjece di bande plui alte e une miôr cualitât dal servizi. A son criptâts e duncje plui dificii di spiâ.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Lis aziendis multimediâls in gjenar a mintissin rispiet al so obietîf e a disin che al covente par “prevignî la piratarie”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: In efiets i codiçs regjonâi no àn propit nissun efiet su la pratiche de copie ilegâl; la copie bit par bit di un disc e funzione ben su ducj i dispositîfs che a lein il disc origjinâl.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Il vêr obietîf al è chel di dâ a chês aziendis plui control sui lôr marcjâts: l’impuartant al è fâ bêçs.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Stant che lis clamadis a son instradadis su Internet, no si scuen par fuarce doprâ une aziende telefoniche cun sede li che si vîf o si viaze.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: No si scuen nancje vê par fuarce un numar locâl de comunitât dulà che si vîf; si pues vê une conession internet satelitâr inte nature salvadie di Chicken, in Alaska, e sielzi un numar che al mostre che si è sot dal soreli de Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Spes si scuen comprâ un numar internazionâl in maniere separade che al permet di ricevi clamadis dai telefons PSTN. La origjin dal numar e je une discriminant pes personis che lu clamin.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplicazions par la traduzion in timp reâl di tescj - aplicazions che a son in grât di tradusi in maniere automatiche tocs intîrs di tescj di une lenghe a chê altre.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Cualchi aplicazion di cheste categorie e pues ancje tradusi tescj in altris lenghis sui segnâi o su altris ogjets dal mont reâl cuant che l’utent al ponte il smartphone viers chei ogjets.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: I motôrs di traduzion a son miorâts une vore e vuê a tradusin dispès in maniere plui o mancul corete (e cun simpri mancul strambolots), dut câs si scuen stâ atents, parcè che a podaressin vê mancjât dut il sens.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Une des aplicazions plui innomenadis in cheste categorie e je Google Translate, che e permet ancje traduzions fûr rêt une volte scjamâts i dâts de lenghe che si vûl.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Doprâ lis aplicazions di navigazion GPS tal smartphone al pues jessi la maniere plui facile e pratiche par movisi cuant che si è tal forest.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Al pues fâ sparagnâ bêçs rispiet al comprâ gnovis mapis pal GPS o un strument GPS autonom o cjoli un a fit di un nauli di machinis.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Se il telefon nol à la conession dâts o cuant che e je fûr di puartade, la lôr prestazion e pues jessi limitade o no disponibil.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Dutis lis drogariis a àn un mâr di cjartis telefonichis prepaiadis che si puedin doprâ tai telefons publics o ta chei ordenaris.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: La plui part des cjartis a van ben par clamâ dapardut, ma ciertis a son specializadis par ufrî tarifis plui buinis par clamâ cierts grups di paîs.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L’acès a chescj servizis si à spes traviers di un numar di telefon gratis che si pues clamâ cu la plui part dai telefons cence paiâ.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Lis regulis par la fotografie normâl a valin ancje, e forsit ancjemò di plui, pes videoregjistrazions.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Se nol è permetût fâ une foto di alc, alore no si varès nancje di pensâ di regjistrâ un video di chê robe.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Cuant che si dopre un dron al è miôr viodi une vore adore ce che si pues filmâ e se a coventin permès o licencis in plui.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Fâ svolâ un dron dongje di un aeropuart o parsore di tante int no je mai une buine idee, ancje se nol è ilegâl inte zone.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: In dì di vuê no si compre cuasi mai un viaç in avion in mût diret de compagnie aerie cence vê prin cirût e confrontât i presits.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: A voltis il stes svol al pues vê presits une vore diferents tai diviers agregadôrs e al val la pene di confrontâ i risultâts di ricercje e ancje di consultâ il sît internet de compagnie di svol prin di prenotâ.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Se al pues no coventâ un vistât par viaçs curts in cierts paîs par turisim o par afârs, par lâ lì tant che student internazionâl in gjenerâl si à di restâ plui timp rispiet a un turist ocasionâl.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: In gjenerâl par restâ intun paîs forest par un periodi lunc si scuen fâsi fâ un vistât in anticip.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: I vistâts pai students di solit a àn recuisîts e proceduris par fâ la domande diferents rispiet ai vistâts normâi par turisim o par afârs.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: La plui part dai paîs e domande une letare di ufierte di bande de istituzion dulà che si vûl lâ a studiâ, e ancje provis che si àn fonts par mantignîsi almancul pal prin an di studi.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Miôr controlâ i detais dai recuisîts cu la istituzion e ancje cul ufici imigrazion dal paîs dulà che si vûl lâ a studiâ.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Fûr che pai diplomatics, lavorâ tal forest di solit al vûl dî che si à di fâ la declarazion dai redits intal paîs ospit.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Lis impuestis sui redits a son struturadis in mût diferent intai diviers Paîs, e lis alicuotis fiscâls e i scaions di redit a cambiin une vore di un Stât a chel altri.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: In cierts paîs federâi, come i Stâts Unîts e il Canadà, la impueste sul redit e ven aplicade sedi a nivel federâl, sedi a nivel locâl, duncje lis alicuotis e i scaions a puedin cambiâ di regjon in regjon.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ancje se i controi dal ufici imigrazion no vegnin fats o a son nome une formalitât cuant che si torne in patrie, i controi doganâi a puedin jessi une secjadure.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Al è miôr sigurâsi di savê ce che si pues introdusi o no tal paîs e declarâ dut ce che al va parsore dai limits legâi.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: La maniere plui semplice par jentrâ tal marcjât de leterature di viaç e je di perfezionâ lis competencis scrivint suntun sît o blog di viaç innomenât.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Une volte che si sa ben cemût formatâ e editâ sul web, si pues pensâ di meti sù un propri sît Internet.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Fâ volontariât vie par un viaç e je une buine maniere par fâ la diference, ma no dut al zire ator dal dâ.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Vivi e fâ volontariât tal forest al è un bon mût par cognossi une culture divierse, int gnove, imparâ alc su se stes, cjalâ lis robis in prospetive e parfin imparâ a fâ alc di gnûf.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: E pues jessi ancje une buine strategjie par sparagnâ e rivâ a stâ plui a lunc intun puest, stant che tancj lavôrs di volontariât a ufrissin di mangjâ e di durmî e un pôcs a dan ancje une piçule retribuzion.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: I Vichincs a doprarin lis tratis navigabilis russis par rivâ tal mâr Neri e tal mâr Caspi. Tocs di chestis tratis si puedin ancjemò doprâ. Al è miôr però viodi se a coventin permès speciâi, che a puedin jessi dificii di vê.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Il canâl mâr Blanc-mâr Baltic al lee il mâr Glaciâl Artic al mâr Baltic traviers dal lât Onega, dal lât Ladoga e di San Peterburc, pe plui part traviers di flums e lâts.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Il lât Onega si lee ancje al Volga, duncje al è pussibil viazâ dal mâr Caspic a traviers de Russie.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Si pues stâ sigûrs che, une volte rivâts tai puarts turistics, dut al sarà clâr. Culì si cjataran altris viazadôrs che a fasin l’autostop in barcje e che a spartissaran lis lôr informazions.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: In pratiche si puedin meti sù anunzis dulà che si ufrìs jutori, zirant pai imbarcjadôrs, domandant a chei che a son daûr a netâ la barcje, cirint di fâsi cualchi contat cui navigants tai bars e vie indenant.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Si pues provâ a fevelâ cun plui int che si pues. Cussì dopo un pôc ducj us cognossaran e us disaran se cualchi barcje e cîr aiût.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Si varès di sielzi cun atenzion il program fedeltât cuntune compagnie di svol che e fâs part di une aleance.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ancje se al somearès logjic iscrivisi al program fedeltât de compagnie di svol che si dopre di plui, si à ancje di tignî presint che i privileçs ufierts di solit a son diviers e i ponts cumulâts a puedin jessi di plui cuntune altre compagnie di svol de stesse aleance.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Lis compagniis di svol come Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways e Turkish Airlines si son slargjadis une vore ancje in Afriche e a ufrissin svoi viers lis citâts africanis plui grandis cun presits plui competitîfs di altris compagniis europeanis.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: A partî dal 2014 la compagnie di svol Turkish Airlines e veve 39 destinazions in 30 paîs africans.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Se si à plui timp par viazâ, si pues provâ a viodi la diference jenfri il presit di un viaç in Afriche e il presit di un biliet par viazâ in dut il mont.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No si à di smenteâsi di zontâ i coscj in plui par ducj i puescj fûr de Afriche: pai vistâts, lis tassis di jessude, il traspuart par vie di tiere e vie indenant.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se si vûl svolâ ator dal mont nome traviers dal emisferi meridionâl, la sielte di svoi e destinazions e je ben limitade, parcè che no esistin tantis tratis transoceanichis.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Nissune aleance di compagniis di svol e cuvierç dutis lis trê traviersadis oceanichis tal emisferi meridionâl (e SkyTeam no cuvierç nancje une).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Dut câs, Star Alliance e cuvierç dut gjavade la zone orientâl dal Pacific meridionâl, o sei di Santiago dal Cile a Tahiti, che al è un svol de compagnie LATAM.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Chest svol no je la uniche sielte se si vûl evitâ il Pacific meridionâl e la cueste ocidentâl de Americhe dal Sud. (viôt sot)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: al 1994 la regjon dal Azerbaizan a maiorance etniche armene Nagorno-Karabakh e declarà vuere ai Aseris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Cul sostegn de Armenie, une gnove republiche e fo creade. Dut câs, nissune nazion costituide (nancje la Armenie) le ricognòs in maniere uficiâl.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Lis discussions diplomatichis rispiet ae regjon a van indevant a vuastâ lis relazions jenfri la Armenie e l’Azerbaizan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Il Distret dai Canâi (par olandês: Grachtengordel) al è il famôs distret dal secul 17m che al cercene il cuartîr di Binnenstad a Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Dut il distret al fâs part dal Patrimoni mondiâl de UNESCO in gracie dal so valôr storic e culturâl straordenari, e il valôr dai imobii culì al è un dai plui alts dal paîs.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Lis Cinque Terre, che al vûl dî cinc tieris, a cjapin dentri i cinc piçui paîs di cueste di Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza e Monterosso che si cjatin te regjon taliane de Ligurie.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: A son te liste dal Patrimoni mondiâl de UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Vie pai secui la int e à tirât sù cun grande cure roncâi di rive tal paisaç rimpinît e salvadi fin sù tai sdrups che a son in face al mâr.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Part dal so incjant e je la mancjance di disvilup aziendâl visibil. Trois, trens e barcjis a coleghin i paîs, e no si pues rivâ fin culì dal difûr cu la machine.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Lis variantis di francês che a son feveladis inte Belgjiche e in Svuizare si distachin pôc pôc dal francês fevelât in France, ma a son avonde similis par capîsi in maniere mutuâl.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Massime il sisteme numeric des areis che a fevelin francês te Belgjiche e Svuizare al à des piçulis particolaritâts che a son diferentis dal francês de France, e ancje la pronunzie di ciertis peraulis e je divierse.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Dut câs, ducj chei che a fevelin francês te Belgjiche e in Svuizare a àn imparât la variante standard a scuele, duncje a capissin ancje se si dopre il sisteme numeric standard doprât in France.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: In tancj puescj tal mont, niçâ la man al è un mot informâl par dî “mandi.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Dut câs in Malesie, almancul jenfri i Malês des zonis rurâls, al vûl dî “ven culì”, come cuant che si plee l’indiç viers il cuarp, un mot che si dopre in cierts paîs ocidentâi, e al à di jessi doprât nome par chel.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: In mût similâr, un britanic in viaç in Spagne al podarès confondi un mot di cumiât cu la palme de man voltade viers se stes (e no viers di chel che si salude) cuntun mot par dî di tornâ indaûr.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Lis lenghis ausiliariis a son lenghis artificiâls o costruidis, creadis cul intent di favorî la comunicazion jenfri personis che se no a varessin dificoltât a comunicâ.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: No son la stesse robe des lenghis francjis, che a son lenghis naturâls o organichis che par une reson o chê altre a deventin il mieç primari di comunicazion jenfri feveladôrs di lenghis diviersis.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Tal scotôr de zornade, i viazadôrs a puedin vê miraçs che a dan la ilusion de aghe (o di altris robis).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: A puedin jessi pericolôs se il viazadôr al decît di lâ incuintri al miraç, butant vie cussì energjie preziose e la aghe che i reste.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ancje tal desert plui cjalt di gnot al pues fâ une vore frêt. Cence vistîts cjalts, la ipotermie e devente un risi grant .
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Soredut in Istât si scuen stâ atents ai mussats se si decît di cjaminâ traviers de foreste pluviâl.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ancje se si viaze in machine traviers de foreste pluviâl subtropicâl, i pôcs seconts cu lis puartis viertis intant che si monte sù te machine a bastin ai mussats par jentrâ tal veicul insiemi dai passizîrs.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: La aviarie, o in mût plui formâl la influence aviarie, e pues infetâ sedi i uciei sedi i mamifars.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: A son stâts regjistrâts mancul di mil câs tai umans, ancje se cualchidun al è stât fatâl.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: La plui part dai câs a son stâts fra la int che e lavore tal setôr aviari, ma il risi al è ancje par chei che a fasin birdwatching.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Aspiets tipics de Norvegje a son i fiorts rimpinîts e lis valadis che di bot a lassin il puest ai altiplans plui o mancul uniformis.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Chescj altiplans a vegnin clamâts spes “vidde”, o sei un lûc viert e ampli cence arbui, une largjure cence limits.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: A Rogaland e a Adger di solit a son clamâts “hei”, o sei un magrêt cerce arbui e spes cuvierzût di grions.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: I glaçârs no son salts ma a sbrissin jù pe mont. fat che al mene a crevaduris e sclapons che a puedin jessi cuvierzûts di puints di nêf.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Lis parêts e i cuvierts des grotis di glaç a puedin sdrumâsi e cuvierzi lis crevaduris.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Des estremitâts dai glaçârs si distachin blocs enormis, a colin jù e magari a saltin o a rodolin vie lontan dal ôr.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: La stagjon turistiche pes stazions di culine di solit e tocje il massim dilunc la Istât indiane.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Par altri a àn un incjant e une bielece diviersis di Invier, cuant che tantis stazions di culine a son cuvierzudis di une buine cuantitât di nêf e a deventin lûcs dulà schiâ o lâ cul snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Nome pocjis compagniis di svol a ufrissin tarifis in câs di corot, che a sbassin di un pôc il presit dai biliets dal ultin minût comprâts par lâ a un funerâl.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Lis compagniis di svol che a ufrissin cheste opzion a son Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa pai svoi dai Stâts Unîts o dal Canadà, e WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Dut câs si scuen prenotâ il biliet par telefon dret cu la compagnie di svol
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
